subject: cat-act-2011-lqa
note: 4A, 2026-10-01, against the Cat Act 2011 compilation 00-l0-01 (currency start 25 Sep 2025) and the Cat Regulations 2012 compilation 02-b0-00 (currency start 24 Jul 2025). Shared by every part: cat-act-facts.l4 (the facts the encoding reads, no rules), wa-interpretation-act-1984.l4 (a byte-identical copy of _jurisdiction/library/wa-interpretation-act-1984.l4, held here because l4 cannot import across folders: see ENCODING-NOTES.md N-01) and cat-cases.l4 (296 #ASSERTs, all satisfied). They are listed under Part 1 so that the 6H digest covers them.

outside this run's scope (Parts 1-2, approved at 3H). Cross-references into them are dispositioned in the reference register: s. 37 (fact), Part 3 Div. 3 reclaiming (fact), Part 4 Div. 4 infringements and Div. 5 objection and review (out of scope)
